entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
I need to return an item. Order number is VF-881-GOLF.
Okay, I can certainly look into that for you. Let me just pull up order VF-881-GOLF... I see the Velo-Guard X helmet. What specifically is the issue with it?
The color is wrong. It doesn't look like it did online. Can I return it, yes or no?
I understand. And just for our records, is the box unopened?
Yes, completely unopened. It's not the right helmet for me.

Absolutely. Your satisfaction and safety are what's most important. Let me just confirm the policy for you... Okay, I see it was delivered five days ago. You are well within our 90-day return window, so I can approve this for a full refund.

I've just processed the return authorization. I'm emailing you a pre-paid shipping label right now. Simply print it, attach it to the box, and drop it at any shipping center. You should have that email in the next minute.
Okay, I see it. Got it. Thanks.
You're very welcome. Once we receive the helmet, your refund will be processed back to your original payment method. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great day.
